position_weight_v2.interpretation_guardrail: Higher cross-position pairwise accuracy is better. Weeks 1-3 are collection only and Weeks 4-7 are early diagnostics only. Do not promote bridge_50 before calibration-review readiness. A promotion case requires improvement versus deployed control in the aggregate, no persistent collapse in major position-pair diagnostics, acceptable normalized-error behavior, and reconciliation with the separately frozen Replacement Level, Production, Age, No-History, Opportunity, and Durability experiments.

production_v2.interpretation: Phase 9 is collecting realized evidence. Results are smoke-test diagnostics only and must not influence coefficients.

replacement_level_v2.interpretation_guardrail: Lower MAE/RMSE is better. The primary decision statistic is position-balanced mean MAE for active-game PPG relative production. Do not select or deploy a replacement-rank family before calibration-review readiness. Weeks 1-3 are collection only; Weeks 4-7 are early diagnostics only. Promotion requires stable improvement versus the frozen legacy control across the aggregate and position-level errors and must be reconciled with the separately frozen Production V2, No-History/Rookie V2, Age Curve V2, Opportunity V2, and Durability V2 experiments.

root_cause_priority_if_systemic_trigger_: First audit/reconcile inherited legacy residuals in migrated DL production multipliers.
Only after that, separately evaluate replacement level and position weight under their already-frozen prospective protocols.
Do not solve a transport-lineage problem by globally lowering all DL values.
what_is_not_proven: The clean-plus-successor counterfactual is not proven to be true market value.
This audit does not prove POSITION_WEIGHT is wrong.
This audit does not prove replacement rank 32 is wrong.
Two weeks of prospective outcomes are not enough to select coefficients.
A Brian Burns manual cap is not scientifically authorized.
what_is_proven: The deployed FV math reproduces exactly for every audited DL/LB.
The position-lineage candidate algebra preserves the pre-existing deployed-vs-legacy-clean residual by construction.
The audit directly measures how much of current migrated-DL FV remains above a current-position-clean-plus-successor counterfactual because of that preserved residual.

uncertainty_context.guardrail: This sensitivity envelope is centered on the deployed value and therefore cannot independently validate the deployed absolute level.
